failure_modes.evidence: The claim states 'A Christian minister who won the singles title with Jan Kodes' — this phrasing is confusing because the claim is about someone who won a DOUBLES title (since Ion Țiriac won men's doubles at 1970 French Open), not singles. This is an entity coreference error in parsing the claim structure.
